title: Road Show
description: Road Show is an end-to-end delivery management platform built to streamline the workflow between operations teams, cashiers, and field delivery agents.

hero.headline: One platform connecting supervisors, cashiers, and drivers.

paragraphs: Road Show is an end-to-end delivery management platform built to streamline the workflow between operations teams, cashiers, and field delivery agents. A powerful web-based dashboard for supervisors, and a companion mobile app for drivers.

process.heading: Delivery operations were running on spreadsheets, phone calls, and guesswork.
process.description: Delivery companies were managing complex, high-volume logistics through disconnected tools. Field agents had no structured workflow. Supervisors had no live view of what was happening on the ground.

phases.title: No Live Dashboard
phases.description: Supervisors had no unified view of pending, in-progress, or completed deliveries across their fleet.

phases.title: Cash Chaos
phases.description: Cash collection from customers was unverified, prone to discrepancies, and had no audit trail.

phases.title: No Driver App
phases.description: Field agents received tasks verbally or on paper — no navigation, no confirmation, no structured status flow.

applications.heading: Command-level visibility for operations teams and a guided experience for field delivery agents.
applications.description: The backend is a modular web dashboard giving operations managers a live, structured view of the entire delivery pipeline.

apps.name: Backend Dashboard
apps.subtitle: 7 modules — Main Dashboard, Customer Mgmt, Route Mgmt, Cashier Mgmt, Task Mgmt, Driver Mgmt

keyChanges.before: No live view of fleet status
keyChanges.after: Main Dashboard with live task status, driver status, delivery heatmap, and calendar overview
Customer Management with view, search, filter, export, and bulk import — reduced to 2 clicks
Route Management to create and manage routes with structured driver-to-route assignment

apps.insight: Six purpose-built dashboard components give supervisors instant situational awareness.

apps.name: Mobile Application
apps.subtitle: 9 screens — Login, On-Duty Toggle, Task List, Cash Collection, Customer Detail, OTP Verification, Fail Reason, Navigate, Status Overview

keyChanges.before: Tasks received verbally or on paper
keyChanges.after: Task List surfacing 45 pending tasks immediately
OTP-based verification creating an auditable, dispute-proof record
Fail Reason Entry with Submit/Discard and Fail–Success status slider

apps.insight: OTP Verification was a critical UX decision — by requiring both driver and customer to confirm via OTP, the system created an auditable, dispute-proof record.

outcome.quote: Designed with intention. Built for the field. Road Show bridges the gap between operational complexity and human simplicity.

deliverables.title: Real-time operational visibility
deliverables.description: Supervisors monitor live task and delivery progress from one dashboard.

deliverables.title: Structured cash reconciliation
deliverables.description: OTP verification eliminated ambiguity and created an auditable trail.

deliverables.title: Driver accountability system
deliverables.description: Fail-reason logging gave managers documented insight into delivery failures.

deliverables.title: 30-screen system delivered
deliverables.description: 21 backend + 9 mobile screens with a unified design system, developer-ready.
